description: This file defines the AttendanceConfigurationModel class implementing an API model that serializes attendance configuration settings for the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates an AttendanceConfiguration object and provides methods to access its data in array form for API responses.

classes.name: AttendanceConfigurationModel
classes.description: A class representing a serializable API model for attendance configuration, implementing necessary interface and providing data conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an AttendanceConfiguration object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model data into an associative array for API serialization.
